summary: Peter Thiel is a venture capitalist and the central figure of the PayPal Mafia. He co-founded Confinity in 1998, became CEO of PayPal after its merger with Elon Musk's X.com, co-founded Palantir in 2003 and Founders Fund in 2005, and was Facebook's first outside investor and a board member from 2005 to 2022. A major Republican donor, he gave $1.25 million to Trump's 2016 campaign and $15 million to a super PAC backing his former employee and protégé JD Vance's 2022 Senate run.
